flee_battle.description: Automatically escapes from a wild Pokémon battle by skipping the introductory screens and choosing the RUN option.
flee_battle.python_script:
import json

# Programmatically generate button presses with sleep commands to bypass introductory screens and escape
sequence = [
    "B",
    "sleep 1500",
    "B",
    "sleep 1500",
    "Down",
    "Right",
    "A"
]

print(json.dumps(sequence))

history.commit_message: Define a simple custom tool to automate navigating to the RUN option in battle.
Define flee_battle tool to automatically flee wild encounters in a clean and standard manner by selecting RUN.
Refining flee_battle to programmatically handle wild battle introductory text and escape in a single turn.

heal_at_center.description: Automates the conversation with Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center counter to successfully heal the party and restore PP, using sleep commands to bypass the automatic B-button text advance.
heal_at_center.python_script:
import json
# Sequence:
# 1. Press A to talk.
# 2. Sleep 1500ms to allow 'Welcome to...' to render.
# 3. Press A to advance.
# 4. Sleep 1500ms to allow 'We heal...' to render.
# 5. Press A to advance to 'Shall we heal...' prompt.
# 6. Sleep 1500ms to allow YES/NO menu to appear.
# 7. Press A to select YES (HEAL).
# 8. Sleep 4500ms to wait out the healing machine animation.
# 9. Press A to advance to 'Thank you for waiting!'.
# 10. Sleep 1500ms.
# 11. Press A to advance to 'We hope to see you again!'.
# 12. Sleep 1500ms.
# 13. Press A to close dialogue.
sequence = [
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 4500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A",
    "sleep 1500",
    "A"
]
print(json.dumps(sequence))

history.commit_message: Initial definition of heal_at_center custom tool

map_id.description: The map ID to navigate (0_228 for 1F, 0_226 for 2F).

travel_mode.description: The travel mode (foot for walking on land, surf for navigating water canals).
